The fix is commit `1c19126f11ca5bb93891bd18d89910d20f41ee84` ("(fix) O3-6097: Fix inverted labels on the free text dosage toggle (#3793)"), which is pull request #3793 in openmrs-esm-patient-chart. The provenance lookup links it to ticket O3-6097 and PR #3793 as verified.

The bug was in the `Toggle` branch of `ControlledFieldInput`. The commit swaps the two labels so that `labelA` is the "Off" label and `labelB` is the "On" label, which matches the toggle's unchecked/checked order. The commit also adds a regression test in `drug-order-form.test.tsx` that checks the toggle shows "Off" when unchecked and "On" when checked.

The fix lines are 981–982 in the post-fix file, and the test was added at `drug-order-form.test.tsx` lines 324–338 of the post-fix file (its hunk starts at line 324 and adds 16 lines). I read the fixed component at that commit to confirm the line numbers. I did not open the test file, so its line range comes from the diff hunk header.
